name_en: Anbin — a sweet potato flour dumpling filled with bean paste, slapped flat
summary_ja: さつまいも粉と小麦粉を熱湯でこね、あんを包んで叩いて平らにし蒸す峡南地域の菓子。あんを叩き入れる仕草が名前の由来とされ、廃校を機に地元が復活させた市川三郷町六郷の伝統食と伝わる。
summary_en: Sweet potato and wheat flour are kneaded with hot water, wrapped around bean paste, slapped flat, and steamed — a sweet from the Kyonan region. Its name is said to come from the slapping motion, revived in Ichikawamisato town's Rokugo area after a local school's closure sparked a heritage-food effort.
source_title: あんびん 山梨県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Oshaka kogori — a lumpy soybean dumpling for the Buddha's birthday
summary_ja: 煎った大豆を混ぜた小麦粉の生地を蒸し、ごつごつと丸めた甲府市などの行事菓子。4月8日の灌仏会（花祭り）に甘茶とともに供えられ、釈迦の頭に似た形から食べると知恵が授かるとされる。
summary_en: Wheat dough mixed with roasted soybeans is steamed into knobby lumps — a festival sweet from around Kofu city, offered with sweet hydrangea tea on April 8th's Buddha's-birthday festival. Shaped to resemble the Buddha's head, it is said to grant wisdom to those who eat it.
source_title: おしゃかこごり 山梨県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Urajiro manju — a mochi-like bun kneaded with the white-backed leaf of oyamabokuchi
summary_ja: キク科オヤマボクチの若葉を練り込み、あんを包んで仕上げる甲州市大和地域の菓子。もとはほうとうのつなぎに使っていた葉の繊維をまんじゅうに応用したのが始まりとされ、草の匂いは控えめと伝わる。
summary_en: Young leaves of the thistle-like oyamabokuchi plant are kneaded into the dough around a sweet bean filling — a confection from the Yamato area of Koshu city, said to have begun when fiber from the same leaf, once used as a binder for hoto noodles, was worked into a bun instead.
source_title: うらじろまんじゅう 山梨県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Tsukino shizuku — a Koshu grape coated whole in hardened sugar glaze
summary_ja: 皮の厚い甲州ぶどうを一粒ずつ、練り上げた白い砂糖蜜にくぐらせて固める甲府の銘菓。江戸時代、和菓子店で煮詰めていた蜜にぶどうが落ちて固まったのが始まりという言い伝えがあり、江戸期の文献にも記されている。
summary_en: Thick-skinned Koshu grapes are dipped one by one in molten sugar glaze and left to harden — a confection from Kofu, said by legend to have begun when a grape fell into boiling sugar syrup at a Kofu sweet shop, and already noted in Edo-period guidebooks.
source_title: 月の雫 山梨県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
